The curve $C$ has equation $x = 8y \tan 2y$
The point $P$ has coordinates $\left(\pi, \frac{\pi}{8}\right)$

parts.label: a
parts.text:
(a)  Verify that $P$ lies on $C$.
(1)
parts.mark_scheme: B1*: Either sub $y=\frac{\pi}{8}$ into $x=8y\tan(2y) \Rightarrow x=8\times\frac{\pi}{8}\tan\left(2\times\frac{\pi}{8}\right)=\pi$, or sub $x=\pi, y=\frac{\pi}{8}$ into $x=8y\tan(2y)\Rightarrow \pi=8\times\frac{\pi}{8}\tan\left(2\times\frac{\pi}{8}\right)=\pi\times 1=\pi$. Accept as a minimum $y=\frac{\pi}{8}\Rightarrow x=\pi\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\pi$, or $\pi=\pi\times\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\pi$. parts.label: b
parts.text:

- $\frac{y-\frac{\pi}{8}}{x-\pi}=\frac{1}{8+4\pi}$, accept $y-\frac{\pi}{8}=0.049(x-\pi)$ M1A1
